Statewide residential design-build

Remodeling and residential construction across Washington.

RT Signature Homes serves qualifying projects across Washington with a coordinated approach to planning, selections, permitting responsibilities, construction, and communication. Project fit depends on the address, scope, timing, and delivery needs.

Check project fit Explore available services
Call (206) 407-6291

How service is evaluated

Statewide service begins with a direct assessment of the property, project goals, and operating plan required to deliver the work responsibly.

What homeowners can expect

  • Ten coordinated residential service lines
  • One consultation path for project and location fit
  • Regional planning for climate, access, materials, and inspections
  • Clear responsibilities from early planning through completion

Available scopes

Services available in Washington

Explore the services most relevant to the market, then use the consultation form to confirm fit for the property and scope.

whole-home remodeling

Whole-Home Remodeling

This service is designed for homeowners changing several rooms, reorganizing the floor plan, modernizing major systems, or preparing a home for its next chapter.

Explore service

kitchen remodeling contractor

Kitchen Remodeling

A strong fit includes full kitchen renovations, layout changes, cabinet replacement, island redesign, and projects that require several trades to work in a precise sequence.

Explore service

bathroom remodeling contractor

Bathroom Remodeling

The service covers complete primary and guest bathroom renovations, layout changes, accessibility improvements, and replacement of outdated or failing assemblies.

Explore service

home addition contractor

Home Additions

This service is for homeowners adding bedrooms, living areas, offices, expanded kitchens, primary suites, or other conditioned space.

Explore service

ADU builder

ADU Design & Construction

The service covers detached and attached ADUs, qualifying garage conversions, and compact living spaces intended for family, guests, work, or rental use.

Explore service

custom home builder

Custom Home Building

This service is intended for homeowners pursuing a ground-up residence with site-specific design, coordinated selections, and professional project delivery.

Explore service

exterior remodeling

Exterior Remodeling

This combined launch service covers coordinated exterior upgrades, including roofing, siding, deck construction, and the junctions between them.

Explore service

flooring contractor

Flooring Installation & Refinishing

The launch service covers flooring replacement, new installation, and qualifying refinishing work across hardwood, LVP, laminate, and tile.

Explore service

interior painting

Interior Painting

The service covers residential walls, ceilings, trim, doors, and qualifying cabinet-painting scopes as standalone work or part of a larger renovation.

Explore service

exterior painting

Exterior Painting

The service covers residential exterior painting and qualifying staining for siding, trim, doors, and related architectural elements.

Explore service

Regional context

Local conditions that shape planning and construction.

Operating model

The project address, scope, schedule, site access, and supervision requirements are evaluated together before the next planning step is recommended.

Available services

Whole-home remodeling, kitchens, bathrooms, additions, ADUs, custom homes, exterior work, flooring, and painting are available for qualifying Washington projects.

Climate

Washington spans wet marine conditions, colder inland winters, dry summers, wind exposure, and varied solar loads. Material and sequencing recommendations should respond to the actual site.

Permitting context

Zoning, building review, inspections, and submittal requirements vary by jurisdiction. The responsible agencies and project-team roles are confirmed during pre-construction.

Housing conditions

Existing homes may combine several construction eras, concealed conditions, additions, and system upgrades. Investigation helps align the design with the building that is actually present.

Qualification guidance

A useful first inquiry includes the ZIP code, desired service, major goals, approximate investment range, timing, and any known property constraints.

Design gallery

Ideas for homes in Washington

Explore service-focused design ideas, materials, and planning considerations, then adapt them to the actual property and regional conditions.

Whole-Home Design Ideas

A whole-home renovation works best when circulation, structure, lighting, storage, and finish selections are considered as one system. These ideas show how individual rooms can share a consistent architectural language without becoming repetitive.

Explore the gallery

Home Addition Design Ideas

An addition should improve the existing home rather than feel attached to it. These ideas focus on massing, rooflines, openings, circulation, daylight, and material transitions between old and new.

Explore the gallery

ADU Design Ideas

A successful ADU makes limited area feel deliberate. These ideas explore compact planning, daylight, privacy, storage, utilities, access, and a respectful relationship to the primary home.

Explore the gallery

Exterior Remodeling Ideas

Exterior work performs best when roofing, siding, openings, flashing, drainage, and outdoor living areas are treated as one weather-protection system. These ideas balance durability and curb appeal.

Explore the gallery

Market questions

Washington service FAQs

Does RT Signature Homes serve all of Washington?

Washington is the statewide service area. Individual project eligibility depends on location, scope, timing, and the logistics required to support the work.

How is a statewide project evaluated?

The first review considers the property location, requested service, project size, timing, design status, permit needs, access, and delivery plan.

Where should we start?

Submit the project ZIP code and a short description. The initial response focuses on fit and the most useful next step.

Start a practical conversation

Discuss a qualifying Washington project.

Share the ZIP code, service, scope, desired timing, and what is driving the project. The first response will focus on fit and the next useful step.
